mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: dip requires the potion-into-potion path (potion_dip)

summary: At step 62, C dodip() has selected the healing potion and asks which potion to dip it into. JavaScript dodip() throws before that second prompt, so the first missing owner is potion.c:dodip(). The C continuation selects a speed potion and produces two diluted extra-healing potions. Port the complete dip route through potion_dip() and its mixture helpers, then wire dip_into() as the other direct caller. A83 reserves objnam.c:simpleonames and hack.c:near_capacity, both reached by the recorded mixture path.

source.branch: For #dip, after getobj() selects the first item and no fountain, sink, or pool handles the action, dodip() must prompt with getobj(qbuf, drink_ok, GETOBJ_NOFLAGS) for the potion and call potion_dip(obj, potion). In this case the first item is a two-potion healing stack and the second is a speed potion; mixtype() returns POT_EXTRA_HEALING and dip_potion_explosion() returns false.
callers: potion.c:dodip() calls potion_dip() after the second selection
potion.c:dip_into() calls potion_dip() for #altdip; js/extcmdlist_data.js maps altdip to dip_into, but js/potion.js has no dip_into implementation
dependencies: getobj(), drink_ok(), dip_ok(), and dip_hands_ok() provide the two object-selection prompts
potion.c:H2Opotion_dip() handles the water-potion branch of potion_dip()
invent.c:freeinv() and hold_another_object(), reached through hold_potion(), remove and reinsert the changed mixture stack
obj.c:useup() and useupall() consume the potion and the affected stack on their respective branches
objnam.c:simpleonames() formats the mixture message and is reserved by A83
hack.c:near_capacity() is called by hold_potion(); it reaches calc_capacity(), inv_weight(), and weight_cap(), all reserved by A83

evidence: The saved baseline challenges/evaluations/20261003183000-v21.json and queue entry show 62/66 screens matched, 2703/2710 RNG calls matched, and a stop at step 62 with “dip requires the potion-into-potion path (potion_dip).”

In the assigned recording challenges/cases/v21/wizard-dips-healing-potion-into-speed-v21-mixture-result.session.json, step 62 selects the healing stack and the C screen asks “What do you want to dip 2 uncursed potions of healing into?”. C potion.c:2365-2371 performs this second getobj() and then calls potion_dip(); js/potion.js:3153-3154 throws before the second prompt, identifying dodip() as the first mismatching source owner.

The same C recording shows step 64 consuming rnd(9)=5 at potion_dip() and rn2(10)=4 at dip_potion_explosion(), so the mixture does not explode. At step 65 the screen reports “The mixture looks puce” and “2 diluted puce potions.” C potion.c:2137-2140 maps POT_HEALING dipped into POT_SPEED to POT_EXTRA_HEALING; potion.c:2503-2593 performs the mixture, consumes the speed potion, sets the result, and reinserts it.

The actionable source group is potion.c:dodip() (2267-2372), potion_dip() (2442 onward), and its used-result helpers mixtype() (2122), dip_potion_explosion() (2417), and hold_potion() (2242); potion.c:2374-2404 shows dip_into() is the second direct potion_dip() caller. js/potion.js currently throws instead of implementing the second prompt, and a targeted search found no JavaScript definitions for potion_dip, dip_into, mixtype, dip_potion_explosion, hold_potion, or poof.

A83 scope artifact .cache/A83-vomiting-dialogue-vomit-scope-event.json reserves source:objnam.c:simpleonames and source:hack.c:near_capacity, calc_capacity, inv_weight, and weight_cap, and lists js/potion.js, js/obj.js, js/hack.js, and js/invent.js as allowed paths. The exact mixture path calls simpleonames() at potion.c:2534 and hold_potion() at 2248-2260, which calls near_capacity(); near_capacity() delegates to calc_capacity() at hack.c:4385-4386, and calc_capacity() uses inv_weight() and weight_cap(). A targeted `rg -n 'sobj_at\s*\(' nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c` returned no matches, so A83’s invent.c:sobj_at reservation is not on this potion source path.
